method: Estimated relative crowd level (0–100) for a typical week in peak season (July–October). Built from official opening hours and closing days, the hourly shape of each type of sight, weekday patterns and each sight's relative popularity. To be replaced by anonymised Istanbul Tourist Pass entry data.

attractions.name: Topkapı Palace
attractions.holiday: Closed on 1 January and on the first day of Ramazan Bayramı.
attractions.answer: Go at 09:00 on a Thursday or Monday and see the Harem first. Wednesday, the day after the Tuesday closure, is a little busier, and weekend middays are the busiest.

offer.title: Topkapı Palace Museum Hosted Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Your pass includes a 30-minute hosted entry with audio guide that skips the ticket line, at 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00 and 15:00. Pick 09:00 for the quietest hour. The Harem is not included.

attractions.name: Hagia Sophia
attractions.hours: From about 09:00; closing time varies by season
attractions.rule: On Fridays the visitor gallery closes from 30 minutes before until 90 minutes after the noon prayer.
attractions.answer: Arrive at 09:00 on a weekday. On Fridays avoid roughly 12:20–14:30, when the gallery closes for the noon prayer and reopens to a queue.

offer.title: Hagia Sophia Guided Tour with Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry
offer.line: Your pass includes a guided tour with skip-the-ticket-line entry, every day except Fridays, at 09:00, 11:45 and 15:15. The 09:00 tour starts in the quietest hour.

attractions.name: Basilica Cistern
attractions.hours: From 09:00; closing and evening session not yet confirmed by the new operator

source.label: istanbul.com Basilica Cistern guide (operator: Vakıflar Genel Müdürlüğü since 2 June 2026)

attractions.answer: Go at opening or late afternoon on a weekday; the narrow walkways fill fastest between 11:00 and 15:00.

offer.title: Basilica Cistern Guided Tour with Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry
offer.line: Your pass includes a guided tour with skip-the-ticket-line entry, every day except Fridays, at 10:30 and 16:30. The 16:30 tour falls in the calmer late afternoon.

attractions.name: Blue Mosque
attractions.hours: Daily from about 08:30, outside the five prayer times
attractions.rule: Closed to visitors at each prayer (about 60–90 minutes) and through the Friday noon prayer.
attractions.answer: Visit between 09:00 and 11:00, before the noon prayer. Skip Friday midday entirely.

offer.title: Blue Mosque Guided Tour
offer.line: Entry to the mosque is free. Your pass adds a guided tour, every day except Fridays.

attractions.name: Istanbul Archaeological Museums
attractions.answer: Rarely crowded: any weekday morning works, and it is the best refuge when Topkapı next door is packed.

offer.title: Istanbul Archaeological Museums Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Can't make it at opening? Your pass includes skip-the-ticket-line entry with audio guide, so you avoid the ticket queue on busy days.

attractions.name: Turkish and Islamic Arts Museum
attractions.answer: One of the calmest museums in Sultanahmet; late afternoon on any day is easy.

offer.title: Turkish and Islamic Arts Museum Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Can't make it at opening? Your pass includes skip-the-ticket-line entry with audio guide, so you avoid the ticket queue on busy days.

attractions.name: Dolmabahçe Palace
attractions.holiday: Closed on 1 January and on the first day of Ramazan and Kurban Bayramı.
attractions.answer: Book the first slot on a Wednesday or Thursday; weekend middays are the busiest time.

offer.title: Dolmabahce Palace Museum Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Can't make it at opening? Your pass includes skip-the-ticket-line entry with audio guide, so you avoid the ticket queue on busy days.

attractions.name: Beylerbeyi Palace
attractions.holiday: Closed on 1 January and on the first day of Ramazan and Kurban Bayramı.
attractions.answer: Quiet on weekdays at almost any hour; even weekend middays are only moderately busy.

offer.title: Beylerbeyi Palace Museum Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Can't make it at opening? Your pass includes skip-the-ticket-line entry with audio guide, so you avoid the ticket queue on busy days.

attractions.name: Yıldız Palace
attractions.holiday: Closed on 1 January and on the first day of Ramazan and Kurban Bayramı.
attractions.answer: Rarely busy. Note the unusual closing day: Wednesday.

offer.title: Yildiz Palace Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Can't make it at opening? Your pass includes skip-the-ticket-line entry with audio guide, so you avoid the ticket queue on busy days.

attractions.name: Ortaköy Mosque
attractions.hours: Daily, outside the five prayer times
attractions.rule: Closes for about half an hour at each prayer and through Friday midday.
attractions.answer: Weekday mornings are calm; the square fills on weekend afternoons.

offer.title: Ortakoy Mosque Walking Tour with Audio Guide
offer.line: Entry to the mosque is free. Your pass adds a walking tour with audio guide.

attractions.name: Rumeli Fortress
attractions.answer: Quiet on weekdays; weekend middays bring local families.

offer.title: Rumeli Fortress Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Your pass includes skip-the-ticket-line entry with audio guide. Our pass page currently notes restoration work, with access limited to the courtyard, so check before you go.

attractions.name: Galata Tower
attractions.answer: For the view without the queue, go at 08:30–10:00. The hour before sunset is the busiest every day.

source.label: Ministry of Culture and Tourism via Milliyet

offer.title: Galata Tower Hosted Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Hosted entry with audio guide that skips the ticket line costs €30 with the pass instead of €40. It runs every day except Fridays, at 10:00, 11:00, 13:30 and 15:00, all before the sunset peak.

attractions.name: Museum of Illusions Istanbul
attractions.answer: Go at 11:00 on a weekday; weekend afternoons are the busiest.

offer.title: Museum of Illusions Istanbul Entry Ticket
offer.line: Your pass includes the entry ticket.

attractions.name: Maiden's Tower
attractions.hours: 09:00–18:00 (last ticket 17:00); boats from Karaköy and Salacak
attractions.answer: Take one of the first boats of the morning; midday on weekends is the busiest.

source.label: Ministry of Culture and Tourism via Bengütürk

offer.title: Maiden's Tower Skip-the-Ticket-Line Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Your pass includes skip-the-ticket-line entry with audio guide. Boats leave Karaköy at 09:30, 11:00, 12:30, 14:00, 15:30 and 17:00; take the 09:30 boat for the quietest visit. The boat ticket is bought separately at the pier.

attractions.name: Spice Bazaar
attractions.holiday: Closed on the first days of religious holidays.
attractions.answer: Before 10:00 is the only calm window; the bazaar averages 50,000–60,000 visitors a day.

offer.title: The Spice Bazaar Walking Tour with Audio Guide
offer.line: Entry to the bazaar is free. Your pass adds a walking tour with audio guide.

attractions.name: Grand Bazaar
attractions.holiday: Closed on Sundays and during Ramazan and Kurban Bayramı.
attractions.answer: Weekday mornings before 11:00 are easiest; Saturday afternoon is the busiest time, and it is closed on Sunday.

offer.title: Grand Bazaar Walking Tour with Audio Guide
offer.line: Entry to the bazaar is free. Your pass adds a walking tour with audio guide.

attractions.name: Süleymaniye Mosque
attractions.hours: Daily, outside the five prayer times
attractions.rule: Pauses at each prayer; plan Friday visits for the afternoon.
attractions.answer: Calmer than the Sultanahmet mosques at any hour; avoid Friday midday.

offer.title: Suleymaniye Mosque Audio-Guided Tour
offer.line: Entry to the mosque is free. Your pass adds an audio-guided tour.

attractions.name: Chora (Kariye)
attractions.rule: Entry also pauses about 15 minutes before each prayer.
attractions.answer: Usually quiet; just avoid Friday, when it is closed to visitors.

offer.title: Chora Church Museum Tickets and Audio Guide
offer.line: Your pass includes the museum ticket and an audio guide.

attractions.name: Eyüp Sultan Mosque
attractions.hours: Daily, outside the five prayer times
attractions.rule: Fridays and religious holidays draw large congregations.
attractions.answer: Go on a weekday morning. Fridays, weekends and religious holidays are the busiest.

offer.title: Eyup Sultan Mosque Walking Tour with Audio Guide
offer.line: Entry to the mosque is free. Your pass adds a walking tour with audio guide.

attractions.name: Miniatürk
attractions.answer: Weekday mornings are near empty; weekend middays bring families. Closed on Mondays.

offer.title: Miniaturk Park Museum Skip the Ticket Line Entry with Audio Guide
offer.line: Can't make it at opening? Your pass includes skip-the-ticket-line entry with audio guide, so you avoid the ticket queue on busy days.

source.label: Istanbul Provincial Directorate of Culture and Tourism, Tourism Statistics Report, December 2025
Official 2027 holiday calendar via CNN Türk

items.name: Republic Day
items.note: Public holiday. Palaces stay open; expect more local visitors.

items.name: New Year's Day
items.note: Topkapı, Dolmabahçe, Beylerbeyi and Yıldız palaces are closed.

items.name: Ramazan Bayramı, day 1 (9–11 March)
items.note: Topkapı, Dolmabahçe, Beylerbeyi and Yıldız palaces are closed on the first day, and the Grand Bazaar closes for the holiday.

items.name: Kurban Bayramı, day 1 (16–19 May)
items.note: Dolmabahçe, Beylerbeyi and Yıldız palaces are closed on the first day (Topkapı stays open), and the Grand Bazaar closes for the holiday.
